import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch.  Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# ChangeSpec name -> branch name conversion.
is_changespec = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_changespec:
        # ChangeSpec ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

marker.step_source:
head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

## What changed

**`src/sase/ace/tui/actions/agent_workflow/_launch_start.py`** — `_finish_agent_launch` now gates on `build_prompt_input_plan` instead of `parse_prompt_input_request`. When nothing needs collecting, the existing fast paths are untouched (including the optional-declared-inputs-only → substitute-defaults branch). Otherwise `_collect_prompt_inputs_then_launch(prompt, plan, keep_bar)` pushes `InputCollectionModal(plan, ...)`; on confirm it records the tags from the **pre-substitution** body (D7, frontmatter excluded per D11), then `apply_prompt_input_values`, then `_launch_resolved_prompt`. Cancel behavior is byte-for-byte today's: bar stays mounted, nothing launches. `agent_count` still derives from `parse_multi_prompt`.

**Config** — new `ace.prompt_inputs` section in `default_config.yml` and `sase.schema.json` with `collect_raw_placeholders` and `xprompt_placeholder_args`, both defaulting to `true`. `build_prompt_input_plan` reads the first through the cached `load_merged_config`, so the submit path adds no disk I/O and the disabled case produces no placeholder fields.

One deliberate deviation worth flagging: I added the `xprompt_placeholder_args` key as data only, without a reader. A public reader with no consumer until phase `xpromptargs` would need a `--epic-symbol` whitelist entry that the next phase then has to remove; letting `xpromptargs` add its own reader is cleaner. The key itself is in place as the plan specifies.

**`Justfile`** — dropped the `sase-9q(apply_prompt_input_values)` and `sase-9q(build_prompt_input_plan)` epic-symbol entries. Both symbols now have real non-test consumers, and symvision hard-errors on stale entries.

**Tests** — 8 new cases in `tests/ace/tui/test_prompt_input_collection_launch.py`, with an autouse fixture stubbing `record_prompt_placeholders` so nothing touches `~/.sase`.
